sentences.text: This animal possessed a very elongated snout and fused pterygoid bones.
A 2025 report described a specimen preserving ninety-five gastroliths found in the La Colonia Formation.
The genus was named in 1990 by Zulma Brandoni de Gasparini and Luis Spalletti.
The holotype specimen MLP 88-IV-10-1 was found near Ingeniero Jacobacci in the Coli Toro Formation and consists of a fragmentary lower jaw.
A more complete specimen, MPEF 650, was found in the La Colonia Formation and includes a half-meter-long lower jaw fragment, skull base, palate, and snout pieces.
The holotype was discovered in Jacobacci, Río Negro province, within the Campanian-age La Colonia Formation.
The outer side of the mandible features a trough, a feature that would be exceptional for a crocodile.
Grooves on the mandible and pterygoids may have housed electro-sensitive organs similar to those in modern river-dwelling cetaceans.
The outer side of the mandible shows a canal, a trait unknown in crocodylomorphs.
Sulcusuchus is classified within the family Polycotylidae.
Sulcusuchus lived from the Campanian to the Maastrichtian, between 83.6 and 66 million years ago.
